name: Desktop
summary: For a VM with a display: a window manager (labwc) with Xwayland and a terminal, and gui to start programs on it.

steps.title: Window manager, Xwayland and a terminal
The session on the display
steps.script:
# The session on the VM's display (the VM's Display setting): labwc, a window
# manager, as the login user on tty7, started at boot when the VM has a
# display. With it: a script that keeps the display the size its window on the
# Mac gives it, and gui, which starts a program on the display from a tab.
lib="$MONAD_ROOT/usr/local/lib/monad"
mkdir -p "$lib" "$MONAD_ROOT/usr/local/bin" "$MONAD_ROOT/etc/systemd/system"
cat > "$lib/display-follow" <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
# Monad: the display takes the size the Mac gives it. When its window on the
# Mac is resized, the kernel lists the new size first among the display's
# modes; the window manager is told to use it, at the scale Monad left in
# monad-display-scale (2 on a Retina screen). "once": now, and no more.
r=${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}
if [ -z "$WAYLAND_DISPLAY" ]; then
    for s in "$r"/wayland-[0-9]*; do
        case $s in *.lock) continue ;; esac
        [ -S "$s" ] && WAYLAND_DISPLAY=${s##*/} && break
    done
fi
export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$r" WAYLAND_DISPLAY
apply() {
    for c in /sys/class/drm/card*-*; do
        [ "$(cat "$c/status" 2>/dev/null)" = connected ] || continue
        mode=$(head -n 1 "$c/modes" 2>/dev/null)
        [ -n "$mode" ] || continue
        out=${c##*/}
        out=${out#card*-}
        scale=$(cat "$r/monad-display-scale" 2>/dev/null)
        case $scale in 1|2|3) ;; *) scale=1 ;; esac
        # A custom mode: the window manager does not read the new size into its own list.
        wlr-randr --output "$out" --custom-mode "$mode" --scale "$scale" >/dev/null 2>&1
    done
}
apply
[ "$1" = once ] && exit 0
# Ends with the window manager that started it (LABWC_PID), at the next change.
udevadm monitor --kernel --subsystem-match=drm 2>/dev/null | while read -r line; do
    if [ -n "$LABWC_PID" ] && ! kill -0 "$LABWC_PID" 2>/dev/null; then exit 0; fi
    case $line in *change*) sleep 0.2; apply ;; esac
done
EOF
chmod 755 "$lib/display-follow"
cat > "$MONAD_ROOT/usr/local/bin/gui" <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
# Monad: gui program [arguments] starts a program with windows on the VM's
# display, from a tab. The VM's Open Desktop (in Monad) shows the display.
if [ $# -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "usage: gui program [arguments]" >&2
    exit 64
fi
r=${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}
WAYLAND_DISPLAY=
for s in "$r"/wayland-[0-9]*; do
    case $s in *.lock) continue ;; esac
    [ -S "$s" ] && WAYLAND_DISPLAY=${s##*/} && break
done
if [ -z "$WAYLAND_DISPLAY" ]; then
    echo "gui: there is no session on this VM's display. Turn on Display in the VM's settings in Monad and restart it." >&2
    exit 69
fi
# Programs that only know X11 reach the session through its Xwayland.
for x in /tmp/.X11-unix/X[0-9]*; do
    [ -S "$x" ] && DISPLAY=:${x##*/X} && export DISPLAY && break
done
export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$r" WAYLAND_DISPLAY XDG_SESSION_TYPE=wayland MOZ_ENABLE_WAYLAND=1
if ! command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "gui: $1 is not a program in this VM." >&2
    exit 127
fi
nohup "$@" >/dev/null 2>&1 &
EOF
chmod 755 "$MONAD_ROOT/usr/local/bin/gui"
cat > "$MONAD_ROOT/etc/systemd/system/monad-display.service" <<EOF
[Unit]
Description=Monad: the session on the VM's display
After=systemd-user-sessions.service
Conflicts=getty@tty7.service
ConditionPathExists=/dev/dri/card0

[Service]
User=$MONAD_USER
PAMName=login
TTYPath=/dev/tty7
TTYReset=yes
TTYVHangup=yes
TTYVTDisallocate=yes
StandardInput=tty-fail
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal
UtmpIdentifier=tty7
UtmpMode=user
Environment=XDG_SESSION_TYPE=wayland LIBSEAT_BACKEND=logind
ExecStartPre=+/usr/bin/chvt 7
ExecStart=/usr/bin/labwc -s /usr/local/lib/monad/display-follow
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable monad-display.service
# A VM without a display (Display is off in its settings) keeps the session for when it has one.
if [ -e "$MONAD_ROOT/dev/dri/card0" ]; then systemctl restart monad-display.service; fi
